messages:
ella: Heads-up: I put together a draft DP invite and a short acceptance checklist. Need quick product + legal alignment before we send.
rahul: can you paste the acceptance bullets here so we can comment inline?
ella: acceptance bullets:
- production/customer-facing use-case
- security contact + questionnaire complete
- run baseline eval set and share results
- agree to weekly 3-question pulse
- choose onboarding track (fast vs eng-supported)
jordan: prefer not to require SOC/TOMs for pilot — heavy lift. NDA + security questionnaire should be enough for cohort this size.
maria: agree. also propose two onboarding tracks so we can scope support: "fast" = self-serve, no infra changes; "eng-supported" = dedicated onboarding + 2 office hours. add a dropdown in the invite.
rahul: how do we decide acceptance? besides checklist, we should weight prospects likely to submit evals and open to feature-level feedback.
ella: thinking scoring: use-case fit (0-3), ability to commit evals (0-3), security fit (0-2). threshold >=6 to accept.
rahul: good. how do we measure feedback quality during the run? propose three signals: avg pulse score, number of distinct bug reports, and eval sample submissions.
jordan: ops metric names to emit: `dp.pulse.score.avg`, `dp.bugs.count`, `dp.eval.samples.count`. would help Console charts and alerts.
maria: ops: we can add tags and a small dashboard tile. what cohort size are we targeting?
ella: propose 16 so we can run two mini-experiments (8/8) on rollout messaging. keeps support bounded.
rahul: compensation? small credit + time seems fair. suggest $250 credits + 2 office hours.
jordan: fine. legal-bot: Consent language reviewed. Edits: retention limited to 45 days, eval samples anonymized unless partner opts in, include explicit opt-in checkbox for extended retention.
ella: noted. also add cancellation / credit reclaim flow: if partner declines or drops before activation, reclaim credits automatically.
rahul: automation notes: on invite acceptance create a Jira ticket under DP-ONBOARD and fire webhook to engagement tool. example payload:
```
POST /dp/webhook
{
  "customer_id": "<id>",
  "track": "fast|eng-supported",
  "consent": true
}
```
jordan: I'll draft the invite copy tonight and include the track dropdown + opt-in checkbox. will share for review. ETA tomorrow morning.
maria: ops will implement tag + dashboard tile once we have the metric names and cohort id. please include cohort_id in webhook.
ella: decision for this thread: cohort=16, acceptance threshold=score>=6, compensation=$250+2hrs, retention=45 days default, opt-in for extended. next step: jordan to post invite draft, rahul to add scoring spreadsheet, legal-bot to confirm final consent text. schedule 20-min sync Fri to finalize. :raised_hands:
